FLANKING.Label: Flanking
FLANKING.SettingBonusHint: Added to melee attack rolls against a flanked target. 0 turns flanking off.
FLANKING.SettingFamiliarNamesHint: Tokens whose name contains one of these words (comma separated) never flank. Familiars summoned with Chris's Premades Find Familiar are recognized automatically.
FLANKING.SettingIconHint: Show the Flanked status on creatures that are flanked right now. It is only a marker: the bonus is always worked out from token positions when the attack is made.
